text:
Hello,

A quick question about timing, if you don't mind.

I rent a studio from Sonnbühl Management Ltd at Feldstrasse 58 in Fribourg, CHF 1120 a month, and have done since August 2022. Money has never been an issue between us. I've always paid on time, Sonnbühl has never sent me a reminder or set me any deadline to pay arrears, and there's no talk of anything like that now.

On 3 September 2026 Ms Alice Steiner from Sonnbühl rang me and mentioned, almost in passing, that the owner is thinking of selling the building and that the tenants "might be getting letters" at some point. That's all. I'm not trying to hang on to the flat or get more time there. Quite the opposite: my girlfriend Eva Lehmann and I have found a bigger place in Marly and would like to move in December.

So far, though, Sonnbühl has not terminated my lease. I haven't received any notice, no letter, no form, nothing by e-mail; there was only that phone call, and Ms Steiner made clear nothing had been decided.

My question is practical. If I give notice myself now, I'd be stuck paying until the next official date in my lease, which is the end of March. Would it be smarter to wait and see whether Sonnbühl terminates first, or to look for a replacement tenant so I can leave earlier? I don't want to end up paying rent on two flats for three months.

Thanks for your help,
Peter Schmid
